# bcdec

Unmodified `bcdec.h` v0.985 from [iOrange/bcdec](https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec), commit `80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c`.

Used under the MIT option in `LICENSE` to decode small native icon regions when a map mod applies a GFX color transform. No full atlas decompression or external artwork is needed.
